== Description ==

[[Mark Billings]] (center, black sunset T-shirt, hair in a bun, glasses, playing) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Ken Cross]] (back right table, Columbia fleece zip jacket, glasses), [[Ming Huo]] (back right table, camel/tan hoodie), [[Nathan Russell]] (back right table, black T-shirt), and [[Jonny Chu]] (back right table, black zip hoodie, glasses); [[Randy Scott]] (mid-left, orange Broncos cap and blue Broncos T-shirt) and [[Daniel Amor]] (mid-left, sage green hoodie, glasses). A player in a tan cap and dark grey fleece (front left) and other background players unlabeled.
